package specutils

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"testing"

	specs "github.com/opencontainers/runtime-spec/specs-go"
	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

func init() {
	// Keep main on the leader, as runsc/sandbox/network_test.go does.
	runtime.LockOSThread()
}

func TestCallingThreadNamespacePath(t *testing.T) {
	runtime.LockOSThread()
	defer runtime.UnlockOSThread()
	tid := unix.Gettid()
	if tid == os.Getpid() {
		t.Fatal("the test needs a nonleader thread")
	}

	path := nsPath(specs.NetworkNamespace)
	if _, err := os.Stat(path); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// The two threads can share a netns. Read the owning task's PID separately
	// so we can tell which procfs directory the helper chose without setns.
	task := filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(path))
	stat, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(task, "stat"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer stat.Close()
	var selected int
	if _, err := fmt.Fscan(stat, &selected); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("namespace path %s selected task %d, calling thread %d, leader %d", path, selected, tid, os.Getpid())
	if selected != tid {
		t.Fatalf("selected the leader instead of the calling thread: %t", selected == os.Getpid())
	}
}
